testcase.name: createInitialActions for Libraries_all should return Action_loadKeyPermissions and Action_syncGroupVersions
createBatchedObjectActions for empty keys and shouldStoreVersion true should return list of storeVersions
createBatchedObjectActions for 20 keys and shouldStoreVersion false should return two batches of actions
createInitialActions for SyncType_normal and list of Libraries_specific libraries should return Action_loadKeyPermissions and list of automatic createLibraryActions
createInitialActions for SyncType_full and list of Libraries_specific libraries should return Action_loadKeyPermissions and list of onlyDownloads createLibraryActions
createGroupActions for full SynkKind normal and Libraries all should return these actions in order resolveDeletedGroup, syncGroupToDb and createLibraryAction with automatic
createInitialActions for Libraries_specific with at least one group library should return Action_loadKeyPermissions and Action_syncGroupVersions
createGroupActions for full SynkKind full and Libraries all should return these actions in order resolveDeletedGroup, syncGroupToDb and createLibraryAction with onlyDownloads

createGroupActions for full SynkKind prioritizeDownloads and Libraries all should return these actions in order resolveDeletedGroup, syncGroupToDb and createLibraryAction with onlyDownloads, onlyWrites
createBatchedObjectActions for two keys and shouldStoreVersion true should return 1 batch of actions with storeVersion action
createBatchedObjectActions for empty keys and shouldStoreVersion false should return list of emptyList
